But wherever and whoever you are, we give you the freedom to bring ideas to life, work that makes a

inclusive community of great people. 

Join us for opportunities to build a varied career, in a company that's building for the future.

# Be Part of Progress

Through our leading brands, trusted for more than 180 years, we provide technology-enabled products,
platforms and services that help researchers to uncover new ideas and share their discoveries. We
are proud to be part of progress and accelerate solutions to address the world’s urgent challenges.

[What we do][33]
[

## Search our content

Search in all books, journals, and other materials published by Springer, Nature Portfolio, and BMC

][34]
[

## License our content

Get access to all our content. A licence is available to academic institutions, governments and
corporations

][35]
[

## Publish with us

Aiming to give you the best publishing experience at every step of your research career

][36]
[

## Learn about Springer Nature

Careers with us, our OA progress report, press releases and investor information

][37]

# Open Science

By opening up access to all outputs of research, we speed up the progress of science. By being open,
we make science and research more equitable, inclusive and effective for all

[Open Science at Springer Nature][38]

## Initiatives

[
[Women in Science ]

### Women in Science

Women have come a long way in enriching the scientific community - yet there's still more to be
achieved. We are recognizing women researchers.

][39]
[
[Sustainable Development Goals]

### Sustainable Development Goals

Springer Nature's Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Programme aims to connect the researchers who
are tackling the world’s toughest challenges with the practitioners in policy and business who need
those insights

][40]
[
[Global Inclusion in Research Publishing]

### Global Inclusion in Research Publishing

We all play a pivotal role in championing inclusive practices and ensuring we reflect our diverse
communities through our publication process. Discover how our Editors are empowered in doing this
through training tools and resources. 

][41]

## Partnerships

We work with others to find and drive forward solutions for the research community
* [
  [SDGs and the impact of open research]
  
  ### SDGs and the impact of open research
  
  A partnership with VSNU and the UKB providing data, insights and tools to advance knowledge about
  how academic research and open research is having a societal impact and accelerating delivery of
  the SDGs
  
  ][42]
* [
  [ORCID: Share your discoveries, receive recognition]
  
  ### ORCID: Share your discoveries, receive recognition
  
  ORCID identifiers give researchers a personal, permanent digital code that distinguishes them from
  every other researcher and links to their publication record, ensuring their work is properly and
  duly recognized.
  
  ][43]
* [
  [In Review: integrated preprint sharing]
  
  ### In Review: integrated preprint sharing
  
  Share a preprint of your manuscript on the Research Square platform and get real time updates
  on your manuscript’s progress through peer review. 
  
  ][44]

environment, our people and communities.

## Planet
## Smart

VitalSource commits to carbon neutrality, reducing our impact on the environment, and creating a
more sustainable future.
* By purchasing a textbook from VitalSource, you have reduced your carbon emissions by 45x compared
  to a print textbook.
* VitalSource invests in reforestation around the world to offset the emissions created by users who

### APIs

We produce high-quality, reliable APIs like antibiotics, antidiabetics, and anti-inflammatories with
GMP certified plants and global regulatory compliance.

### Intermediates

development with scalable, R&D backed solutions.

### Specialty Chemicals

and Methyl Nicotinate.

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.

* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs.

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

[Learn More][36]
[Download The Framework][37]

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

Aristo Pharma, headquartered in Berlin, was founded in 2008 and is now one of the fast-growing
pharmaceutical companies in Europe.

Our ambition is to rethink healthcare and continuously advance pharmaceutical solutions – with the
goal of making therapies effective, well-tolerated, and easy to use at the same time.

Our portfolio includes prescription medicines, innovative medical devices, OTC products, and herbal
preparations, covering a broad spectrum of modern healthcare solutions.

More than 1,400 employees across 13 countries contribute every day to ensuring that our products
reliably reach where they are needed most – physicians, pharmacies, wholesalers, and patients.

# 2026 SF Healthcare Week

[ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The CEO
behind this year's pancreatic cancer breakthrough walks us through the full results and implications
| 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
13:17

### ASCO 2026: "The results that we presented from the RASolute 302 trial are unprecedented." - The
### CEO behind this year's pancreatic cancer breakthrough walks us through the full results and
### implications | 05/31/26

Dr. Mark Goldsmith of Revolution Medicines describes the benefit seen by advanced patients who
received the pancreatic cancer pill daraxonrasib vs those in a control group of investigator's
choice standard-of-care chemotherapy, and he discusses the medicine's side effect profile. Plus,
next steps for this treatment in pancreatic cancer and beyond.
[ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative head &
neck | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
05:44

### ASCO 2026: Bicara Therapeutics is presenting long-term follow up data at ASCO that it believes
### shows durability derived from choosing TGF-β with EGFR for its fusion protein in HPV negative
### head & neck | 05/31/26

CEO Claire Mazumdar describes the ASCO data, and updates us on the phase 2/3 study, which is already
in the phase 3 portion. Bicara hopes to use the study to eventually gain an accelerated approval.
[ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26]
Play Video
Play Video
35:05

### ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.
[ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO data
release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26]
Play Video
Play Video
14:55

### ASCO 2026: Summit Therapeutics' Co-CEO and Chief Strategy Officer discuss the HARMONi-6 ASCO
### data release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26

Maky Zanganeh and Dave Gancarz share their take on the result, which at the topline showed that
Ivonescimab plus chemo reduced the risk of death by 34% vs the PD-1 Tislelizumab plus chemo, and
they are given the opportunity to respond to some of the pushback heard around McCormick Place.
[ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2- breast
| 06/02/26]
Play Video
Play Video
09:22

### ASCO 2026: Celcuity CEO Brian Sullivan discusses the late breaking data for the PAM inhibitor
### gedatolisib that was just presented at ASCO - doubled the likelihood of survival in HR+/HER2-
### breast | 06/02/26

These data were for patients with the PIK3CA mutation. The median PFS for the gedatolisib triplet
combo was 11.1 months versus 5.6 months, compared to alpelisib plus fulvestrant.
[ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK in
1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not overshadow this
| 06/1/26]
Play Video
Play Video
15:58

### ASCO 2026: Immuneering presented an update of the P2 trial of its deep cyclic inhibitor of MEK
### in 1L pancreatic cancer at ASCO. CEO Ben Zeskind argues why competitor data should not
### overshadow this | 06/1/26

He describes the data, which showed a 17.3 months median OS in 55 patients vs. 8.5 months for SoC,
and descrbies why he believes the therapy has an ideal profile for first line patients. A phase
three study is already active and accruing patients.

# Driving partner success with reliable, expert-driven CDMO services

At Bora Pharmaceuticals, it is our shared responsibility to execute every drug program reliably on
time, consistently in full.

[ Get in touch today ][54]

## A global pharmaceutical manufacturing partner
* From sites in North America and Asia, Bora delivers reliable, high-quality drug products to 100+
  markets around the globe

Bora Pharmaceuticals is a global contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO)
specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical
products.

From our nine cGMP facilities across three countries, Bora Pharmaceuticals delivers drug products
with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

Working for a Safer Drug Supply Chain

The Bulk Pharmaceuticals Task Force (BPTF) is an industry trade organization representing
manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates and excipients. BPTF
addresses regulatory and quality issues related to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
compliance. 

 

 

[Prescription Drugs]
[[Bar Chart]][11]
[[FDA-White-Oak-Building-01.jpg]][12]
[[Business Brainstorm]][13]

Quality Performance

BPTF is focused on quality throughout the supply chain. Creating a quality culture in manufacturing
requires dilligence and a need to keep informed and aware of ever-changing regulatory guidance
and industry standards.

 

Engaged

BPTF is a key stakeholder in negotiations with FDA on authorization of the Generic Drug User Fee
Amendments (GDUFA) and works with an array of industry trade groups to stay abreast of all
developments in the drug industry.

Advocacy

BPTF is a trusted industry voice respected within the drug supply chain and trusted by influential
leaders working on supply chain safety.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

## About Us

BYJU'S is India's largest ed-tech company and the creator of India's most loved school learning app.
Launched in 2015, BYJU'S offers highly personalised and effective learning programs for classes 1 -
12 (K-12), and aspirants of competitive exams like JEE, IAS etc. With 50 million registered students
and 3.5 million paid subscriptions, BYJU'S has become one of the most preferred education platforms
across the globe.

## What Makes Us Different?

# Personalised Learning

Our niche is creating personalised learning experiences for every type of learner. The BYJU'S way of
learning provides students a learning platform where they can learn, engage and be excited about
charting their own path to discover the world. BYJU'S - The Learning App brings together the best
teachers, technology, content, media for creating a seamless, world class learning experience for
each and every student.

## Why Choose Us?

Learning is pivotal for a student's success in academics and life. The Digital Age is deeply shaping
the way students learn and will also determine their future prospects. At BYJU'S, we encourage
students to embrace this fast, changing world and making them ready for tomorrow by being their
constant learning partner.

We craft learning journeys for every student that address their unique needs. We believe in the
power of one-to-one learning that addresses every child's learning needs, allows students to be
holistically involved in their education and be active, lifelong learners.

## Our Three Pillars

## Personalised Learning Journeys

Personalised Learning- is the foundation of our unique programs for students. Using knowledge
graphs, the program adapts and creates personalised learning journeys for students. It provides a
comprehensive coverage of over 1 lakh concepts with animated videos and questions, fun quizzes and
flashcards.

Based on the student's progress, personal learning profiles are created which help analyse strengths
and areas of improvement. Each concept gets tagged at different levels of difficulty to create a
smooth learning curve which keeps students motivated through any new learning challenge. Whenever
errors are made, motivating remedial methods are generated to strengthen and improve the student's
learning experience.

## Technology Enabled Learning

At BYJU'S, we leverage technology to merge best practices like use of videos, engaging content and
quizzes with the best teachers so that every child across the globe has access to the best learning
experiences.

Key features of the learning program:
* Interactive and engaging learning modules
* Visually rich content to enable conceptual clarity and lifelong term retention
* Personalised learning programs designed for every student, enabled by the power of data science


## Best Teachers & Engaging Content

The BYJU'S Learning Programs provide students a holistic learning experience. Students across
regions can access the best teachers and see concepts come to life. Every detail of a student's
journey is planned and executed at the deepest level with subject matter experts, teachers and tools
like videos, interactive animations, quizzes and assessments.

The app integrates these well crafted lessons from our teachers and assessments along with analysis
and recommendations, personalised to suit each student's learning style. This holistic approach has
seen a student engagement of over 71 minutes a day, being spent by a student on the app,making it
one of the most loved apps for students across age groups.

We at BYJU'S work towards offering students the best learning experience. We have courses for
students across ages and grades:
* Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology for CBSE and ISC (Classes 1-12)
* Competitive Exams- JEE, NEET, IAS preparation courses

## Payment

BYJU'S offers you multiple payment methods. Payment gateway partners use secure encryption
technology to keep your transaction details confidential at all times. You may use Internet Banking,
Wallet and QR Support to make your purchase.

isolated facts, you work through a changing differential as each clue appears. The format is simple:
one daily case, one diagnosis to identify, and one archive where older cases stay useful for
repeatable reasoning practice.

Commit to a diagnosis early, reveal clues only when needed, and force yourself to update the
differential with each new piece of information.

### Read the opening case

Start with a concise chief complaint and commit to an early differential before the extra clues
appear.

### Refine with clue reveals

Each wrong guess or manual reveal unlocks another clue.

### Turn mistakes into review

Finish the case, review the explanation, and copy an Anki-ready card for future spaced repetition.

## Why people play Doctordle

Doctordle works best when you want compact but high-yield diagnostic reps instead of a long passive
review block.

### Fast, focused repetition

Each case fits into a short study break while still making you commit to a diagnosis before extra
information appears.

### Reasoning before recall

Wrong answers create useful friction. The clue-by-clue format trains you to revise the differential
instead of pattern-matching too early.

### Built for memory, not just scoring

of ending at the reveal.

uncertainty, then review the explanation.

Practice moving from chief complaint to differential diagnosis under the same uncertainty that shows
up in shelf-style and Step-style stems.

### Repeatable archive review

diagnostic thinking without waiting for the next release.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."

By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."

And you never see the raw data.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different

# WHO-GMP Certified Sterile Injectable Manufacturer – Exporting Quality Globally

## Trusted CDMO & CMO Partner for Global Pharmaceutical Companies

Farbe Firma Pvt. Ltd. is a WHO-GMP-certified pharmaceutical company specializing in sterile
injectable formulations for international markets. Based in India and driven by world-class
manufacturing, we deliver ampoules, liquid vials, lyophilized vials, emulsions, and critical-care
products for partners worldwide.


With advanced manufacturing technology and high-capacity production lines, we deliver world-class
quality and reliability as a trusted CDMO/CMO partner for global pharmaceutical companies seeking
contract manufacturing excellence.

[Explore More ][15]

• Advanced, fully automated sterile production lines

• High-capacity output for global pharmaceutical demand

• Dedicated R&D for innovative injectable formulations

• Complete CDMO/CMO contract manufacturing services

• Regulatory-compliant export documentation support

## Our Manufacturing Capabilities

## Pharmaceutical Exporter Serving 30+ Countries Worldwide

Headquartered in India, Farbe Firma serves healthcare providers, distributors, and pharmaceutical
companies across Asia, Africa, Europe, Latin America, and CIS countries. Our robust export
infrastructure includes:

• Complete regulatory documentation and dossier support
• International quality certifications (WHO-GMP compliant)
• Efficient logistics and cold-chain management
• Multi-lingual customer support team
• Flexible order quantities for global partners

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

## boundaries of accessibility

[slide_innovation]
[slide_patient]
[slide_globally]

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

By combining our deep scientific expertise with agile commercial strategies, we are uniquely

healthcare professionals, and  healthcare segments worldwide.

## Join Us

At Glenmark, we want talent to build more than a career. We want them to undertake a quest full of
substance and meaning.

Where chasing breakthroughs is part of the everyday and shaping the future of global health the
goal.

Where we live, breathe and deliver innovation while also expanding accessibility to high-quality
products for patients around the world.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

# Your trusted pharmaceutical partner.

Serving healthcare professionals and patients with trusted, evidence-based pharmaceutical products —
across oncology, nephrology, biotherapy and critical care.

Therapeutic focus

## Four specialty areas. Each chosen for clinical need.

We register and supply medicines in therapeutic areas where Kenyan patients face the largest access
gaps and where consistent, quality-assured supply matters most for clinical outcomes.

[
[Cispire 50 — Cisplatin Injection B.P.]

### Oncology

Cytotoxics, hormonal and supportive-care agents for solid tumours and haematological malignancies.

Explore
][16] [
[Ferrin — Iron Sucrose Injection USP 20 mg/ml] 02 · Nephrology

### Nephrology

Erythropoiesis-stimulating agents, iron therapy, anticoagulants and immunosuppression for renal
patients.

Explore
][17] [
03 · Biotherapy

### Biotherapy

Plasma-derived therapies — coagulation factors, immunoglobulins and human albumin.

Explore
][18] [
04 · Critical Care

### Critical Care & Hospital

Anaesthesia adjuncts, neuromuscular blockers and other hospital-specialist injectables.

Explore
][19]
Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

[Full capabilities][21]
Built around the prescriber

## The people who choose the medicine are the people we work for.

Oncologists, nephrologists, hospital pharmacists, intensivists, procurement officers — these are the
audiences our scientific office, regulatory team and supply chain are designed around.

If you are one of them and you need product information, supply confirmation or a tender response,
our team is one enquiry away.

[Contact our team][22]
For healthcare professionals

## Need product information, availability or supply support?

Our scientific office responds to medical-information requests, hospital-procurement enquiries and
tender queries within one working day.

[Contact our team][23] [How we work][24]

Beyond filings

## India Entry, GTM, M&A and Feasibility, backed by global research.

For global enterprises entering India, and Indian companies expanding across markets and capital.
KAMRIT runs the strategy work alongside the filings. Our sister firm Claight (same directors, same
shareholders) supplies the market intelligence, sector research, and procurement data that informs
every recommendation.

1
**India Entry & Feasibility Studies**

Pre-feasibility, market sizing, FDI route, entity selection, regulatory mapping, and 90-180-365 day
operating plan.

2
**GTM Strategy & Channel Architecture**

Six to ten week sprints ending in a binding plan: segment priorities, channel design, P&L, hiring
and regulatory checklist.

3
**M&A, Valuation & Transfer Pricing**

Buy-side and sell-side advisory, registered-valuer reports, transfer pricing studies and 3CEB
filings.

[Plan your India entry][53] [Read GTM playbook][54]
Why KAMRIT

## India's most trusted compliance partner.

15+ years of expertise. Senior-partner accountability. 100% online tracking. No hidden charges.

01

### Senior partner accountability

Every engagement is owned end to end by a partner. No layered teams, no chasing analysts.

02

### Fixed-fee transparent pricing

Published prices for every service. No surprise invoices. Monthly retainers for ongoing compliance.

03

### 100% online delivery

Track applications, documents, and due dates in one dashboard. File from anywhere in India.

04

### India-wide and global

Headquartered in Delhi and Noida, serving clients across India, plus USA, UK, Singapore, and UAE
setup.

How it works

## From enquiry to filing in four steps.

### Tell us what you need

Share a quick description of your business and the service you need. A KAMRIT expert reviews it
within one business day.

### Document review

We send you a precise document checklist. Your dedicated expert reviews everything before any portal
submission.

### Online filing

We file with MCA, GSTN, Income Tax, IPO, RBI, or the relevant authority and track every
notification.

### Approval & ongoing support

You receive your certificate, PAN, GSTIN, or registration number with full digital backup. We stay
on for ongoing compliance.

[Start your filing today][55]
Industries we serve

## Industry-specific advisory across India.

From e-commerce and SaaS to manufacturing and exports, KAMRIT supports businesses across every
industry domain.

[E-commerce & D2C][56] [SaaS & Technology][57] [Manufacturing][58] [Retail & Consumer Goods][59]
[Healthcare & Pharma][60] [Real Estate & Construction][61] [Logistics & Supply Chain][62] [Financial
Services][63] [Education & EdTech][64] [Food & Beverage][65] [Exports & Trading][66] [Agriculture &
Agritech][67] [Energy & Renewables][68] [Automotive][69] [Aerospace & Defence][70] [Media &
Entertainment][71] [Consulting & Professional Services][72]
5+ Years of professional service since 2020
12 Practice areas under one accountable team
100+ Indian and global clients served
4 Office locations: Delhi (HQ), Noida, plus partner offices

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

industry domain.

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.

  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate

  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

## "Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value!"

### Khandelwal Associates is a Pharmaceutical Logistics Company, established in the year 1989.
### Providing services to more than 700 clients since 33 years. The firm majors in four services
### which are Carrying and Forwarding Agency Consignee Agency, Distributorship and Mother Warehouse
### Facility. Infrastructure with ultra-modern IT facilities and spacious warehouses. Provision of
### generator at the warehouse for uninterrupted power supply. Cold Room Facilities are also
### available for storage.
* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate
  vision and the aim to achieve unparalleled success.
* 1995 : After years of conscientious practice in Pharmaceutical Business, we became associated with
  one of the top firms in the Pharmaceutical field, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
* 2003 - 2004 : We established our main head office in indore with in house facilities for
  hospitality, support, operations, cold chain facilities, material handeling and three warehouses.
  Also got associated with Zuventus Healthcare Ltd.
* 2005 : Association with Medopharm Pharmaceuticals.
* 2008 - 2011 : Collaborated with Adley Labs, Gennova Biopharmaceuticals, Cachet Pharmaceuticals
  Private Limited and Talent Healthcare.
* 2013 - 2014 : We became C&F agents for Koey Pharmaceuticals and also became Adley Mother Warehouse
  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

* July 21, 2026

CICO occurs when adequate alveolar oxygen delivery cannot be achieved despite best attempts at all
three upper airway rescue techniques ("Lifelines"): face mask ventilation, supraglottic airway
ventilation, and tracheal intubation. CICO management involves recognition of CICO, priming for
FONA, and transition to FONA.
