## Our mission is simple:

The Manuals, *known as the Merck Manuals in the United States and Canada and MSD Manuals outside the
United States and Canada,* are one of the world’s most widely used medical information resources.
The Manuals are committed to [making the best current medical information accessible][5] to health
care professionals and patients on every continent.

We believe that health information is a universal right and that every person is entitled to
accurate and accessible medical information. We have a responsibility to protect, preserve and share
the best current medical information to enable more informed decisions, enhance relationships
between patients and professionals, and improve health care outcomes around the world.

That’s why we are making the Merck Manuals and the MSD Manuals available for free in digital form in
multiple languages to professionals and patients around the world.

## Merck and the Merck Manuals

At Merck (known as MSD outside the United States and Canada) we are unified around our purpose: We
use the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world. For more than 130
years, we have brought hope to humanity through the development of important medicines and vaccines.
We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company in the world – and today,
we are at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the
prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals.

First published in 1899 as a small reference book for physicians and pharmacists, The Merck Manual
grew in size and scope to become one of the world's most widely used comprehensive medical resources
for professionals and consumers. As The Manual evolved, it continually expanded the reach and depth
of its offerings to reflect the mission of providing the best medical information to a wide
cross-section of users, including medical professionals and students, veterinarians and veterinary
students, and consumers. Learn more about our commitment to [Global Medical Knowledge][6].

## Merck and the Merck Manuals

At Merck (known as MSD outside the United States and Canada) we are unified around our purpose: We
use the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world. For more than 130
years, we have brought hope to humanity through the development of important medicines and vaccines.
We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company in the world – and today,
we are at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the
prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals.

First published in 1899 as a small reference book for physicians and pharmacists, The Merck Manual
grew in size and scope to become one of the world's most widely used comprehensive medical resources
for professionals and consumers. As The Manual evolved, it continually expanded the reach and depth
of its offerings to reflect the mission of providing the best medical information to a wide
cross-section of users, including medical professionals and students, veterinarians and veterinary
students, and consumers. Learn more about our commitment to [Global Medical Knowledge][6].

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

Every GLP-1 weight-management medicine licensed in the UK is prescription-only, so a site that sells

the prescriber on the GMC register, and treat a price well under the registered-pharmacy range as a
warning rather than a find. The MHRA reported seizing more than 5,000 illegally traded GLP-1
products in 2025 alone.

## Frequently Asked Questions

## What is Global Pharma Distributor?

Global Pharma Distributor (GPD) is an MHRA-licensed pharmaceutical wholesaler based in the United
Kingdom. From a regulated UK facility, GPD prepares GDP-compliant medicines and medical supplies for
licensed importers, government health ministries, and NGO programmes worldwide, supported by
temperature-controlled storage, batch verification, and documented export records.

## Is GPD MHRA licensed?

Yes. GPD holds a Wholesale Dealer Authorisation (Human), or WDA(H), issued by the UK Medicines and
Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA). It allows GPD to procure, hold, and export human
medicines to other businesses under GDP, with a designated Responsible Person accountable for
compliance. Export documentation, batch records, and temperature logs are kept in line with MHRA
requirements.

## Which regions does GPD export to?

GPD supports authorised importers across Africa and the Middle East, working with licensed partners
under their own national regulators. Each shipment is prepared with MHRA-backed documentation and
GDP-aligned handling suited to institutional procurement and regulated import processes. For
regional detail, see the Middle East pharmaceutical exports hub.

## Does GPD supply NGOs and donor-funded health programmes?

GPD supports procurement teams and authorised importers connected to NGOs and donor-funded health
initiatives. It prepares verified medicines and medical supplies for buyers working within global
health frameworks, and provides the export documentation and temperature records those programmes
rely on for accountability. GPD works through authorised importers and makes no claim of direct
programme affiliation.

## How does GPD maintain temperature control during pharmaceutical exports?

GPD maintains temperature-controlled storage at its regulated UK facility, where
temperature-sensitive products are held in monitored conditions and packed with calibrated
monitoring devices. For international transit, temperature-controlled handling is coordinated
through validated logistics partners working to GDP frameworks. Each consignment carries documented
temperature records that support regulatory review and buyer verification.

## What products does GPD distribute?

GPD handles branded pharmaceuticals, generic medicines, over-the-counter products, medical devices,
and medical supply kits. Categories can include essential medicines, antiretrovirals, antimalarials,
temperature-sensitive vaccines, and hospital consumables. Everything is sourced from approved UK and
European suppliers under GPD’s wholesale dealer authorisation.

## Where is GPD's warehouse located?

GPD operates from a regulated pharmaceutical facility near London Heathrow Airport, set up for
temperature-controlled storage and export preparation under GDP standards. The Heathrow location
helps GPD coordinate international freight efficiently for the licensed importers it serves.

## Does GPD provide procurement consulting support?

Yes. Alongside supply, GPD offers operational support such as product sourcing guidance,
documentation preparation, and logistics coordination for cross-border orders. These services help
licensed importers and institutional buyers manage regulated supply chains with fewer gaps.

## How can licensed importers request a quotation?

Licensed importers, government procurement offices, and NGO programme managers can contact GPD’s
compliance team for export documentation or a quotation. Enquiries are handled in line with GPD’s
MHRA obligations and confidentiality procedures, and qualified enquiries receive a response with
preliminary documentation guidance.

# Aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für flüssige Produkte von Rommelag

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Technologie

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

assessments, diagnoses, treatments, and health outcomes. The Medical Research Network on SSRN is an
open access preprint server that provides a venue for authors to showcase their research papers in
medicine in our research community, speeding up dissemination and providing the scientific community
access to groundbreaking working papers, early-stage research, clinical research, and even peer
reviewed or published journal articles.

library, speeding up the dissemination and providing the scholarly community access to
groundbreaking working papers, early stage research and even peer reviewed or published journal
articles. SSRN provides the opportunity to share different outputs of research such as preprints,
preliminary or exploratory investigations, book chapters, PhD dissertations, course and teaching
materials, presentations, and posters among others.

Law is the basis of a functioning modern society. Laws dictate how members of a society must act and
proscribe certain acts. From international laws to local ordinances, multiple layers of laws impact
our daily lives. An understanding of law is necessary to analyze and understand interactions between
individuals, businesses, and governments. The Legal Scholarship Network on SSRN is an open access
preprint server that provides a venue for authors to showcase their research papers in our digital
library, speeding up the dissemination and providing the scholarly community access to
groundbreaking working papers and early-stage research.

groundbreaking working papers and early-stage research. SSRN provides the opportunity to share
different outputs of research such as preprints, preliminary or exploratory investigations, book

### **How to Study in Germany E-BOOK**


**Learn How to Study in Germany Through the Heartfelt Conversations of Two Besties**

It’s not every day that you find a friend who is super eager to help and spare you days of research…
right?

Well, the co-protagonist of our story, Zoe, has such a best friend—her name is Mia, and Mia is
basically a walking encyclopedia when it comes to studying in Germany.

Mia is a few years older than Zoe and has just returned from studying abroad in Germany.

Now, she wants to help Zoe out with her dream of studying abroad, too! She answers Zoe’s every
question: **choosing a program, admission requirements, the application process, visa requirements,
the blocked account, health insurance, and so much more.**

[Download for Free][57]

### **The Essential Guide to Studying in Germany**


Every beautiful journey begins with **just one step**. This e-book is **your first step** to
studying in Germany.

It guides you through everything—from securing your money and gaining university admission to taking
your first step into the breathtaking world of Germany. **It’s literally all here! **

Written by experts who paid close attention to every detail, big or small, so you get all the
information you need.

And if you still have questions after reading our guide, don’t worry… we’ll have a stern talk with
our experts!

Just kidding, nobody is perfect, but our guide pretty much has all the answers you need. 

Are you ready to start your studies in Germany? With this guide, you will be, in no time!

  * ##### Всероссийская научно-практическая конференция с международным участием «Профилактическая
    ##### медицина — 2026» *08 июля 2026*
    
    Для участия в конференции приглашаются сотрудники органов и учреждений, подведомственных
    Минздраву России и Роспотребнадзору, образовательных организаций высшего и дополнительного
    профессионального медицинского образования, должностные лица органов исполнительной власти,
    курирующие вопросы укрепления общественного здоровья и оказания медицинской помощи населению,
    обучающиеся медицинских вузов по программам специалитета, магистратуры, ординатуры, аспирантуры,
    другие заинтересованные лица.
    
    [Подробнее][186]
    
    
    ##### Проректор по развитию регионального здравоохранения и медико-профилактическому направлению
    ##### СЗГМУ им. И.И. Мечникова А.В. Мельцер принял участие в Санкт-Петербургском международном
    ##### экологическом форуме «Экология большого города» *03 апреля 2026*
    
    Александр Витальевич принял участие в работе круглого стола «Состояние окружающей среды и
    качество жизни крупных городских агломераций на примере Санкт Петербурга и Москвы. Экологические
    проблемы и решения», представив доклад, посвящённый анализу экологической ситуации в мегаполисах
    и рассмотрению перспективных мер по её улучшению.
    
    [Подробнее][187]
    
    
    ##### Научно-практическая конференция «Актуальные проблемы медицины труда в военном деле»,
    ##### посвященная 100-летию со дня рождения доктора медицинских наук профессора Виктора
    ##### Георгиевича Чвырёва *04 марта 2026*
    
    04 февраля 2026 г. кафедрой медицины труда СЗГМУ им. И.И. Мечникова была проведена
    научно-практическая конференция «Актуальные проблемы медицины труда в военном деле», посвященная
    100-летию со дня рождения доктора медицинских наук профессора Виктора Георгиевича Чвырёва.
    
    [Подробнее][188]

Environmental, Social, and Governance

## We Create Lasting Solutions
## That Drive Change

Our ESG commitment shapes how we develop, manufacture, and deliver active pharmaceutical ingredients
(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

[Learn More][112]
Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

## That Drive Change

(APIs) and CDMO services, with a long-term view toward shared value and global well-being.

Environmental

### Sustainable Practices for a Greener Future

We are committed to minimizing our environmental footprint by integrating eco-conscious practices
into our production and supply chain. From investing in energy-efficient technologies to reducing
water usage and chemical waste, we actively pursue greener processes without compromising quality or
compliance.

Governance

### Integrity and Accountability in Action

We maintain rigorous compliance standards, transparent reporting, and ethical business practices
across our global operations. From quality control to cybersecurity, our governance framework
ensures accountability and risk management at every level.

Social

### Empowering Communities and People Wordwide

People are at the heart of everything we do, and we collaborate with our partners and communities to
promote health, education, and opportunity. Ethical labor practices, ongoing workforce development,
and a commitment to health equity are key pillars of our social impact strategy.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### [ Is The General a good car insurance company? ][54]

We’re proud to say that The General is one of the best car insurance companies in the business.
Don’t just take our word for it: Credit-rating agency AM Best gives these insurance companies an
“A+/Superior” rating for financial stability, 2nd highest out of 13 ratings.

At The General, we provide auto insurance coverage even for the high-risk drivers that other
insurance companies won’t insure. Many insurers do not cover drivers who found themselves without
insurance for six months or more, but that’s not an issue at The General. We know that not everyone
has perfect credit or an outstanding driving record, but they still need car insurance.

### [How long has The General Insurance been in business? ][55]

The General opened for business in 1963. We’ve grown enormously since then but still retain our core
value of providing all drivers with affordable coverage.

Our nearly 60 years in business is important when you’re choosing car insurance. Our longtime
customers know they can depend on The General auto insurance when an accident happens. The insurance
industry relies on trust: Our customers must trust us to help them in what is sometimes among the
most difficult times in their lives. Many of our clients are second-and third-generation, coming to
us via recommendations from family and friends.

Through the years, we’ve invested in state-of-the-art technology. Our award-winning mobile app lets
you make a payment, report a claim, and manage your policy anywhere, at any time. It’s just one
example of how The General constantly upgrades our tech to offer the customer the best experience.

### [ How much does The General car insurance cost? ][56]

How much you’ll pay for car insurance depends on several factors, and no two people are alike. Get a
free, no-obligation quote and find out what we can do for you. The General car insurance quote
requires your ZIP Code, (which reveals your local accident rate), and other personal information
such as your age, credit history, and family insurance exclusions.

If you decide to buy a policy after getting your online quote, we'll need the following for all
drivers & vehicles in your household to give you a specific premium amount:
* Name
* Address
* Driver’s license number
* Vehicle identification number

If you like your quote—and you almost surely will—you can go ahead and buy your policy online.
Choose your payment method and submit the application with a click or a touch. Just print out the
insurance card, and you’re good to go!

### [ What states does The General car insurance cover? ][57]

You can buy The General insurance in 46 states and Washington, D.C. How much you’ll pay for car
insurance slightly depends on the state you live in. We provide policies for drivers in both fault
and no-fault states. In fault states, or tort states, those injured in an accident caused by a
driver can sue for damages from the at-fault party. In a no-fault state, each driver’s insurance
company pays for their medical bills and lost wages after an accident, unless the injuries are
significant.

Generally, if you live in a city, expect to pay more in premiums than if you lived in a rural area.
Places with higher amounts of traffic have more collisions.

There are also different state requirements when it comes to minimum amounts of car insurance you
are required to carry. Most people should buy more than the minimum amount if they can afford it.
Additional insurance protects your personal assets in case of a serious crash.

### [ What types of insurance does The General offer? ][58]

The General offers a full range of coverage options. Every driver must buy the minimum amount of
liability coverage required by their state. Liability insurance pays for damage you caused by the
at-fault driver to people and vehicles. It does not pay for your medical expenses, lost wages, or
car repairs.

If your car is leased or you still owe payments on it, the lessor or lender is going to require you
to carry collision and comprehensive car insurance. Even if you own your car, you might still want
this coverage if you can’t afford to replace it after a crash.

Comprehensive coverage pays for damage caused by anything other than a collision. This might include
theft, vandalism, hail or a tree falling on the car.

### [ Does The General car insurance have full coverage? ][59]

Yes, The General auto insurance offers full coverage for drivers. Full coverage means the driver
wants more than just liability coverage. Full coverage includes not only comprehensive and collision
insurance, but uninsured or underinsured motorist insurance.

While most states don’t require you to buy uninsured or underinsured motorist coverage, it’s a good
idea. Auto insurance agents must offer you this option in most states. There are too many uninsured
or underinsured drivers on the roads, and getting into an accident with one can really hurt you
financially without this type of coverage.

How much coverage you’ll need depends on your personal situation. If you have assets, such as a
house or investments, you want to make sure you have enough insurance in case of a serious crash.
Otherwise, you could lose these assets in a lawsuit. If you don’t have much in the way of assets,
you won’t need as much insurance, but you must carry the minimum amount of insurance required to
legally operate a vehicle in your state.

free, no-obligation quote and find out what we can do for you. The General car insurance quote
requires your ZIP Code, (which reveals your local accident rate), and other personal information
such as your age, credit history, and family insurance exclusions.

If you decide to buy a policy after getting your online quote, we'll need the following for all
drivers & vehicles in your household to give you a specific premium amount:
* Name
* Address
* Driver’s license number
* Vehicle identification number

If you like your quote—and you almost surely will—you can go ahead and buy your policy online.
Choose your payment method and submit the application with a click or a touch. Just print out the
insurance card, and you’re good to go!

### [ What states does The General car insurance cover? ][57]

You can buy The General insurance in 46 states and Washington, D.C. How much you’ll pay for car
insurance slightly depends on the state you live in. We provide policies for drivers in both fault
and no-fault states. In fault states, or tort states, those injured in an accident caused by a
driver can sue for damages from the at-fault party. In a no-fault state, each driver’s insurance
company pays for their medical bills and lost wages after an accident, unless the injuries are
significant.

Generally, if you live in a city, expect to pay more in premiums than if you lived in a rural area.
Places with higher amounts of traffic have more collisions.

There are also different state requirements when it comes to minimum amounts of car insurance you
are required to carry. Most people should buy more than the minimum amount if they can afford it.
Additional insurance protects your personal assets in case of a serious crash.

### [ What types of insurance does The General offer? ][58]

The General offers a full range of coverage options. Every driver must buy the minimum amount of
liability coverage required by their state. Liability insurance pays for damage you caused by the
at-fault driver to people and vehicles. It does not pay for your medical expenses, lost wages, or
car repairs.

If your car is leased or you still owe payments on it, the lessor or lender is going to require you
to carry collision and comprehensive car insurance. Even if you own your car, you might still want
this coverage if you can’t afford to replace it after a crash.

Comprehensive coverage pays for damage caused by anything other than a collision. This might include
theft, vandalism, hail or a tree falling on the car.

### [ Does The General car insurance have full coverage? ][59]

Yes, The General auto insurance offers full coverage for drivers. Full coverage means the driver
wants more than just liability coverage. Full coverage includes not only comprehensive and collision
insurance, but uninsured or underinsured motorist insurance.

While most states don’t require you to buy uninsured or underinsured motorist coverage, it’s a good
idea. Auto insurance agents must offer you this option in most states. There are too many uninsured
or underinsured drivers on the roads, and getting into an accident with one can really hurt you
financially without this type of coverage.

How much coverage you’ll need depends on your personal situation. If you have assets, such as a
house or investments, you want to make sure you have enough insurance in case of a serious crash.
Otherwise, you could lose these assets in a lawsuit. If you don’t have much in the way of assets,
you won’t need as much insurance, but you must carry the minimum amount of insurance required to
legally operate a vehicle in your state.

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

[woman holding capsule]
* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.
* 2015
  
  We streamlined the capsule manufacturing filling process with the launch of Ultra III®, a
  high-speed, semi-automatic filling machine, providing drug developers with an innovative and
  flexible solution to meet a wide array of filling requirements.
* 2016
  
  The first customer commercialized our proprietary lipid multi-particulate technology,
  strengthening our positioning as an industry-leading partner in the nutraceutical and
  pharmaceutical markets.
* 2017
  
  We purchased Capsugel and InterHealth to create a leading integrated solutions provider to the
  global pharma and consumer healthcare industries.
* 2019
  
  In response to changing regulations and consumer demand for an alternative solution, we created
  the Vcaps® Plus White Opal® capsule. This is a titanium dioxide-free, white colored capsule that
  is suitable for vegan and vegetarian diets, as well as being allergen and gluten-free.
* 2020
  
  The Lonza Engine® Alliance Program was launched. This is our partnership with some of the world’s
  leading equipment manufacturers, where we offer reliable powder-filling equipment, plus
  world-class service and support capabilities.

  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.

  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.
* 2015
  
  We streamlined the capsule manufacturing filling process with the launch of Ultra III®, a
  high-speed, semi-automatic filling machine, providing drug developers with an innovative and
  flexible solution to meet a wide array of filling requirements.
* 2016
  
  The first customer commercialized our proprietary lipid multi-particulate technology,
  strengthening our positioning as an industry-leading partner in the nutraceutical and
  pharmaceutical markets.
* 2017
  
  We purchased Capsugel and InterHealth to create a leading integrated solutions provider to the
  global pharma and consumer healthcare industries.

enhance the quality of medical education worldwide, with promotion of the highest scientific and
ethical standards in medical education. This objective is met through the development of standards
in medical education, by the promotion of accreditation of medical schools, with the development of
databases on medical education, through projects on the future of medicine and medical education,

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

# A legacy of 70 years in bringing innovative pharmaceutical solutions to life

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
